messages:
Mateo Rivera: FYI, saw a big spike in request queueing around 03:12 UTC and the warm pool emptied faster than autoscaler could bring new nodes up. latency SLOs were hit for ~90s.
Alice Chen: ugh. Is this the same pattern as the Friday evening surge?
Mateo Rivera: similar but worse — several regions (us-west1 + eu-west1) hit capacity and we queued. Autoscaler respect cooldown + scale-in protection prevented aggressive scale-out.
Priya Singh: do we have metrics on warm pool hit rate vs on-demand spin-up latency?
Mateo Rivera: yes — attaching quick numbers: warm-pool hit rate dropped to 18%, median spin-up from 0->ready was 42s, p95 88s. Queue length peaked at ~320 requests.
Dan Park: cost will go up if we just increase warm pool size across the board :grimacing: any targeted approach?
Alice Chen: thought: tune warm-pool sizing by region and model-family. High QPS routes use dedicated warm pools, low QPS keep smaller. Also increase pre-warm threshold for routes with high burstiness.
Mateo Rivera: +1. Also propose adding a short-term admission-control token bucket per-region to shed a few percent rather than letting queue blow up.
Priya Singh: agree. Token-bucket limits + fast-fail for non-critical routes. We should also lower the autoscaler target utilization temporarily to make it more sensitive to incoming bursts.
Dan Park: what about hysteresis? if cooldown is 300s we should allow a higher sensitivity for scale-out vs scale-in. Make separate scale-out cooldown of 30s, scale-in 600s?
Mateo Rivera: that would help. My suggested changes to test in staging:
```
# autoscaler snippet
scale_target: 0.6 # lower from 0.75
scale_out_cooldown: 30s
scale_in_cooldown: 600s
warm_pool_min: { us-west1: 12, eu-west1: 8, ap-south1: 2 }
prewarm_threshold: 120rps
```
Alice Chen: let's also add a soft queue-length admission rule: if queue > 200 then token-bucket rate drop to 70% and route non-urgent jobs to best-effort cluster.
Priya Singh: And add a warm-preloader job that keeps a small number of instances running a light health check + KV cache warm. That reduces cold-starts for model KV loads.
Dan Park: cost estimate? If we bump warm_pool_min in two regions, that's ~+0.9 FTEs monthly cost eq, or ~$12k/month. Is that acceptable?
Mateo Rivera: we can run a 2-week Canary in us-west1 only, watch cost/latency. If benefits > 30% p95 improvement it's worth it.
infra-bot: deploy triggered by @Mateo Rivera: infra/autoscale-tuning -> staging at 2025-03-11T10:40:00Z
Alice Chen: Action items: 1) Mateo to land autoscaler + warm-pool config in staging, 2) Priya to add token-bucket admission and soft-fail routes, 3) Dan to produce cost delta. Target: monitor for next 48h.
Mateo Rivera: I'll open a PR and tag you all. Starting now.
Priya Singh: I'll prototype the admission controller rule this afternoon.
Dan Park: I'll run cost sims and post numbers tomorrow.
Alice Chen: Thanks team :thumbsup:
Mateo Rivera: will follow up with short postmortem if staging confirms.
